notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RustyLakePublisherSale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33523087/85101fe90af9f7530ffd1c19793018841c016d64.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3]Happy 10 years of Rusty Lake![/h3] 🥳 And what better way to celebrate a decade of Rusty Lake than with:

[list]
[*] [b]A new free-to-play game: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show [/b]- hat tricks, sleight of hand, and a few unexpected reveals you don’t want to miss; 
[*] An early look at our upcoming [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/]premium Rusty Lake game[/url]
[*] And special Rusty Lake anniversary merch in collaboration with Lost in Cult, including [b]a re-release of the iconic [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/rusty-l-para-8lfct]Paradox Comic Book[/url][/b] - available to pre-order right now;
[*] A week-long platform-wide discounts of up to[b] 66% OFF on all our premium games[/b], including hosting our very own [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RustyLakePublisherSale]Rusty Lake Anniversary Steam Sale Page[/url]
[/list]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/RustyLakePublisherSale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11705021/5652015001432a81055e8c711cd22d40e082cd56.png[/img][/url]

Of course, the sale includes [b]Rusty Lake: Hotel[/b], which you can now download and play for [b]66% off[/b]! Make sure each dinner is to die for!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/435120/Rusty_Lake_Hotel/

And don't forget to check out our [b]new magical puzzle game: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show[/b]. A free-to-play short but magical game filled with enough secrets and unexpected twists to put you in a celebratory mood!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3472550/The_Mr_Rabbit_Magic_Show/

Keep an eye out for secrets while playing The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show, and you might just find an early look at our next Rusty Lake adventure! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/]Wishlist now[/url] to stay up to date!

[url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/rusty-l-para-8lfct-awfzj-6r6yf-fjy72][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33523087/79fc9db394a84f82d17eecccf67771e750806427.png[/img][/url]

As a special thank-you for your continued support over the past 10 years, we’re excited to further delight you with some special Rusty Lake anniversary merch in collaboration with Lost in Cult available to pre-order as of April 30th:

[list]
[*] 🎵 Rusty Lake: [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/rustylake]Sounds of the Lake 10th Anniversary Vinyl Collection[/url] - 20 of Rusty Lake’s Greatest Hits performed by Victor Butzelaar. 
[*] 🃏 A mysterious [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/rustylake]deck of cards[/url] (perfect for your own magic tricks) - designed by Maarten Pelders, inspired by the series’ surreal symbols and characters.
[*] 📖 A re-launch of our fan-favourite [url=https://www.lostincult.co.uk/shop/p/rusty-l-para-8lfct]Paradox Comic Book[/url] by Lau Kwong Shing.
[/list]
Whether you’ve been a part of our Rusty Lake universe since the first launch of a Cube Escape title back in 2015, or you’ve joined our journey during our later years, we’d like to share a heartfelt Thank you! from the whole Rusty Lake team! 

Thanks to you and your incredible support, we’ve had an amazing 10 years, and we’re as excited as ever to continue exploring the mysteries of Rusty Lake with more video games, short films, tablet-top experiences and much more! We hope you’ll stick around for what’s to come!

The past is never dead.

notes.title: Rusty Lake Hotel is Now 44% OFF | More updates from The Lake
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11705021/0fde4d536e93153a464c15727bcfc02b6c910ee0.png[/img]

Hey everyone! All our premium games are now on sale in the SteamSummerSale for 44% OFF!  And to make the summer sale even better, our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/3669/Rusty_Lake_Bundle/]Rusty Lake Bundle[/url] is 52% OFF!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/435120/Rusty_Lake_Hotel/

And with the sale, we bring forth some insights into our plans at Rusty Lake:

[h3]Physical Escape Room[/h3]

Lately, we have been very busy with our first physical escape room: Rusty Lake’s Black Cube Exhibition which went live during TwitchCon Rotterdam. The experience turned out to be a huge success, so we hope to bring it to other future conventions, if possible.  Read more on our [url=https://blog.rustylake.com/our-first-physical-went-live-at-twitchcon/]blog[/url]!

[h3]Rusty Lake Untold[/h3]

For the past 2 years, we’ve also been working on our first pen & paper, tabletop, escape room: Rusty Lake Untold. We are thrilled to release our first adventure: The Lab for free later this month: on July 24! Make sure to sign up [url=https://www.rustylakeuntold.com/]here[/url] and read how to play.

[h3]Follow the meaning[/h3]

We are also collaborating with Hiking Mind studio to release their debut title Follow the meaning through our publishing platform: Second Maze. The game is a premium point-and-click adventure with beautiful graphics and playtime of around 1.5 hours. They aim to release in Q3 and we think a lot of people who enjoy Rusty Lake will also enjoy this adventure so make sure to wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2720280/Follow_the_meaning/  

Of course, we are also working on new game projects, but unfortunately, we cannot share anything about those plans just yet!

Stay tuned!

PS. All our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/secondmaze]Second Maze games[/url] are also 44% OFF in the Steam Summer Sale!

notes.title: The Past Within + Rusty Lake Midweek Madness
notes.content:
We are very excited to announce our upcoming title The Past Within:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1515210/The_Past_Within/ 

Are you ready to unlock The Past Within? Teaming up with a friend, travel through both past and future to piece together the mysteries surrounding Albert Vanderboom. Communicate what you see around you to help one another solve various puzzles and explore the worlds from different perspectives!

Official teaser trailer:

[previewyoutube=bopzNbExy1Q;full][/previewyoutube]

The Past Within is an upcoming multiplayer point-and-click adventure taking place in the Rusty Lake universe. Next to PC & Mac, the game is also coming to IOS, Android and hopefully console!

Please keep in mind that the development of this game is still in an early stage: we still have a long way to go before we can communicate a release date! Stay tuned on our social media, our blog or on Steam for more information / development logs.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rustylake][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37623373/7eb60367c1a92592a8c6307e44c5802491354ec5.png[/img][/url]

Together with this big announcement and the 5 year anniversary of our first premium game released on Steam, Rusty Lake: Hotel, we’d like to celebrate alongside all of you with a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/rustylake]50% discount on all of our Steam games[/url]! Thank you for all your love and support, we wouldn’t be here without all of you wishlisting, reviewing and sharing your enthusiasm for our games on Steam!

Thank you all for your support, stay safe and greetings from The Lake!

notes.title: The Cube Escape Collection is now available! 🎉
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33593611/cf0f6f168ff467c1a553bc23068435a1e744ffc6.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone!

We’re very excited to finally release a Collection of the first nine Cube Escape chapters on Steam to survive the end of the Flash Games era:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection/

We hope you will be happy to finally have all these games in one place where you can easily revisit the Rusty Lake universe and unlock all the 72 new achievements! There is also a new hint system and our translators did a tremendous job adding translations to all of them.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UTKfF1K1MUg

We are celebrating this much-awaited release with a sale, as a small thank you to all of you for the amazing support you’ve shown us over the years. When we released our first Cube Escape game, Seasons, 5 years ago we never dreamed we would attract such an amazing community. To this day we’re still blown away by your continuous support and kind words. Thank you for being such a big part of the Rusty Lake journey!

Good luck finding all the achievements and please stay tuned for future Rusty Lake updates!

Thanks for your support! The past is never dead 🦐

Rusty Lake

Important:
- We really appreciate your feedback! Feel free to leave a review in the store!
- Any bugs/glitches? Please let us know on [url=https://discord.gg/rustylake]Discord[/url] or at support@rustylake.com.
- All our games (including The White Door) are on 50% sale as well for today - please keep an eye on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/rustylake]Steam page[/url]!
- The Collection contains 9 chapters: Seasons, The Lake, Arles, Harvey's Box, Case 23, The Mill, Birthday, Theatre and The Cave. Paradox will be available separately.
- These games do not contain any new content from their original versions (besides achievements, a new hint system and translations)!

notes.title: Samsara Room is out now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11705021/2347428be1f0f6f4965ef63d59e34091fd0a2a8e.png[/img]

Samsara Room is a new atmospheric point-and-click adventure by the creators of Rusty Lake and Cube Escape series. This praised predecessor to the Rusty Lake universe is completely re-assembled with brand new puzzles, story, graphics and an immersive soundtrack by Victor Butzelaar.

Celebrate our five year anniversary with us, download and play for free now! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1281800/Samsara_Room/

One of our next steps is to make nine chapters of the Cube Escape series available on Steam! Expect a small price for this bundle, but this way we can preserve this series on PC for the foreseeable future! Wishlist now: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292940/Cube_Escape_Collection/?curator_clanid=33593611

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: The Itch.io summer sale includes Thumper and The Signal From T lva for cheaps
notes.content:
Games. You want them, Itch.io sells them, and to facilitate that process it’s put 606 of the things on sale.

I like that they’ve taken the polar opposite approach to Steam’s shenanigans for their own summer sale, and surrounded the discounts with absolutely zero guff. I know some people buy into the badges and whatnot, but after years of Valve’s bombarding me with cutesy treehouse animals, those avatars have started landing on the manipulative side of corporate fun. Read on for my picks from this refreshingly minimalist sale, which include the likes of heart-squelching rhythm action-game Thumper and soul-squashing robo-shooter The Signal from T lva . (more…)

notes.title: Wot I Think: Rusty Lake: Roots
notes.content:
Rusty Lake Hotel [official site] is a game I have meant to write about on RPS for so long. I missed its release, and found it by luck on my phone when searching for interesting escape-the-room games. And wow, did I find interesting. And not only did I discover the incredible Rusty Lake Hotel game, a dark and devastatingly creepy murder mystery adventure, but also their catalogue of remarkably unsettling and often brilliant free Cube Escape games. Each release fits into a larger mythology that feels ominously huge and yet barely understood, awful stories of gruesome deaths and mysterious looming bird-headed figures, time-bending weirdness, and an overriding notion of cruelty that’s hard to quantify. In short, they’re completely wonderful. So I enter Rusty Lake: Roots [official site] with a great sense of anticipation. Here’s wot I think:

notes.title: A message to the community and some background info!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.rustylake.com/press/Rusty%20Lake%20Hotel/images/logo.png[/img]

First of all we would like to thank you for all the support so far! It’s been quite a rollercoaster ride since we got Greenlite on Steam. We never expected so many downloads, reviews and extra press attention. We’re glad to see the community is so involved, we enjoy the interaction in the community hub :) 

We also would like to share some background info about our work:

 It’s was Spring 2015 when we (2 devs) created our own imaginative world called Rusty Lake. This world, inspired by the Twin Peaks series, became known as the Cube Escape series: surrealistic room escape games with classic point-and-click gameplay. The games are easy to play but get more complex on the way. Each chapter is somehow connected which each other and each game reveals more about the Rusty Lake mystery. 

After publishing 6 free Cube Escape games on web and mobile, we were forced to try out a bigger, premium game, since we didn't earned a lot with the free games. So at the end of October 2015 we choose a different direction and started developing Rusty Lake Hotel. 

Rusty Lake Hotel is a bit of a side-step from the Cube Escape games, making it more suitable for premium. We did our best to improve a lot, not only with the art and puzzle design, but also with the audio and storyline. And of course some replay value with the optional ingredients. The game has a lot connections and small hints to our previous Cube Escape series. People who have played the series will recognize characters and some parts story become more clear (including the ending).   If you would like to get to know more of Rusty Lake Hotel and our work, you can check the Cube Escape series for free on [url=http://www.rustylake.com]Rusty Lake[/url] or 
[url=http://www.cubeescape.com]Cube Escape[/url]. Some people requested it already but for now this series won’t be available on Steam, the series remain free on our websites. We would like to suggest the following order to play the series:

Cube Escape: Seasons 
 Cube Escape: The Lake  
Cube Escape: Arles  
Cube Escape: Harvey's Box 
Cube Escape: Case 23 
 Cube Escape: The Mill  
Cube Escape: Birthday

Thanks to all the support of Rusty Lake Hotel we have published Cube Escape: Birthday 10 days ago, which contains a lot of connections to Rusty Lake Hotel. You can even use a secret code from (if you have all 3 stars on the dishes) in this game to get more insights of what happened.

At the moment we’re developing a new Cube Escape, but we already have plans for a new premium game later this year (which we hope to get on Steam:)).  

Thanks again for all the support! You can follow us on:
[url=https://www.facebook.com/rustylakecom]Facebook[/url] 
[url=https://twitter.com/rustylakecom]Twitter[/url] 
or subscribe to our mailing list: [url=http://eepurl.com/bhphw1]http://eepurl.com/bhphw1[/url]
